texts.title_ja: ピラミッド・テクスト 第300節
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
O King, you have not departed dead, you have departed alive
You shall pass through the wall of the West

texts.title_ja: ピラミッド・テクスト 第466節
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
You have your spirit, you have your power
The field-rushes of the Beyond are open to you

texts.title_ja: コフィン・テクスト 第335節
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I am Atum at the dawn of creation
I am Khepri, who came into being of himself

texts.title_ja: 死者の書 第125章「否定告白」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I have not committed evil against humans
I have not abused cattle
I have not blasphemed a god

texts.title_ja: 古代エジプト「ハーピストの歌」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
None comes from there to tell of their lot,
To tell of their needs, to calm our hearts
Until we go where they have gone
Let thy heart not sink

texts.title_ja: 古代エジプト『アメンエムオペの教訓』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Beware of robbing the wretched
Of raising your hand against the disabled
Do not commit fraud against boundary stones

texts.title_ja: 古代エジプト恋歌 チェスター・ビーティ・パピルス
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Seven days are passed and I haven't seen my sister
Sickness has invaded me, I have become heavy in my limbs
I have forgotten my own body

texts.title_ja: 古代エジプト「私の愛は唯一」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
My beloved, unique, without peer,
More beautiful than any other,
Look, she is like the star goddess rising at year's start

texts.title_ja: シヌヘ物語（詩的部分）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
He flew up to heaven and was united with the sun-disk
The limb of the god being merged with him who made him

texts.title_ja: アクスム・エザナ王碑文
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
By the might of the Lord of Heaven, who is in heaven and earth
Victorious for me, I, Ezana son of Ella Amida

texts.title_ja: 『ケブラ・ナガスト』第32章 ソロモンとシェバ
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
And the Queen of Sheba came to Solomon
And the king made a wreath of glory upon her head

texts.title_ja: スンジャタ「足萎えのライオン」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Sundiata could not walk like other children
He crawled on his belly until age seven
Then one day he stood on his own legs

texts.title_ja: スンジャタ「キリナの戦い」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Sundiata met Sumanguru on the field of Kirina
The spear flew like rain, the arrows like locusts
Many were the warriors who fell that day

texts.title_ja: スンジャタ叙事詩 グリオの序
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I am a griot. It is I, Djeli Mamoudou Kouyate,
son of Bintou Kouyate and Djeli Kedian Kouyate,
master in the art of eloquence

texts.title_ja: ムウィンド叙事詩 誕生
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
In the womb of his mother, Mwindo spoke
He was born from his mother's middle finger
Walking and speaking from his birth

texts.title_ja: ムウィンド叙事詩 冥界の旅
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Mwindo descended into the realm of his father Shemwindo
Through the place where the sun does not rise
He spoke the names of all dead heroes

texts.title_ja: シャカ・ズール イズィボンゴ（讃辞）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
UDlungwana kaMenzi! UDlungwana woMbelebele,
Odlung' emanxulumeni!
Uyangidlangana yaye libuhlungu

texts.title_ja: ディンガネ王 イズィボンゴ
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Dingane! Son of Senzangakhona!
The one who came after the storm
The wing of the bird that flies high

texts.title_ja: ヨルバ・オリキ「オロクン讃辞」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Olokun, you who are vast as the sea
You whose hair is the seaweed of the deep
You whose voice is the roaring of the breakers

texts.title_ja: ヨルバ・オリキ「シャンゴ讃辞」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Shango! Owner of the wood-pestle
Kabiyesi! Kabiyesi! Kabiyesi!
Fire that burns in the heart of the mountain

texts.title_ja: ヨルバ・イファ「オバラ・メジ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The diviner who drinks no palm-wine cannot prophesy clearly
Ifa is the white kola of yesterday
Ifa is the bitter kola of today

texts.title_ja: アカン格言詩
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Tete wo bi ka — There is something to learn from the past
Obi nkyere abofra Nyame — No one shows a child God
The mind is its own home

texts.title_ja: アシャンティ・アポー（葬送歌）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Death has cut down our great tree
We weep for the chief who has gone
The ancestors call him by name

texts.title_ja: リヨンゴ・フモ叙事詩
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Liyongo, son of Mringwari
Who was tall as a baobab tree
Who fought with bow and spear

texts.title_ja: ムヤカ・ビン・ハジ ディーワーン
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Pwani ni kunde kavu kuvunda mawimbi
Na watu walokuwa walikuwa
Kilichopita ni kama upepo

texts.title_ja: ザンビア成人式歌
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Now you are no longer a child
The great mother teaches you the way
Go and live wisely

texts.title_ja: ダホメー戦闘歌
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
We march, we march to victory
We carry the spear of our king
The enemy will tremble before us

texts.title_ja: マダガスカル・ハインテニー
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Tia ny tany izay misy ny rano
Tia ny ono izay misy ny tia
Misy fitiavana izay tsy mety simba

texts.title_ja: コサ・イントソミ（物語詩）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Once long ago there lived a maiden
More beautiful than the rising sun
She danced upon the hilltops

texts.title_ja: ネサワルコヨトル「問う」
texts.era_period: 前コロンブス・メキシコ
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Yo Nezahualcóyotl lo pregunto:
¿Acaso de veras se vive con raíz en la tierra?
No para siempre en la tierra:
sólo un poco aquí.

texts.title_ja: カンタレス・メヒカノス「モクテスマ詩」
texts.era_period: 前コロンブス・メキシコ
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Llorad, amigos míos, llorad por nuestra ciudad
Nuestras flechas se han quebrado
El águila ha caído

texts.title_ja: カンタレス「アヨクアン」
texts.era_period: 前コロンブス・メキシコ
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Del interior del cielo vienen
las bellas flores, los bellos cantos.
Los afea nuestro anhelo,
nuestra inventiva los echa a perder

texts.title_ja: トチウィトシン・コヨルチウキ
texts.era_period: 前コロンブス・メキシコ
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Sólo venimos a soñar, sólo venimos a soñar.
No es verdad, no es verdad,
Que venimos a vivir en la tierra

texts.title_ja: マクイルショチトル女詩人「歌」
texts.era_period: 前コロンブス・メキシコ
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Eleva mis cantos, oh tú, mi pluma quetzal,
Mi creador, dador de vida
Que florezcan tus cantos por todas partes

texts.title_ja: チラム・バラム書 預言
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Bin u kuxlahaj a alabal in than
Be will alive my words spoken
The time of the prophet is at hand

texts.title_ja: ポポル・ヴフ 創世第1部
ポポル・ヴフ 人間創造
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
De maíz amarillo y de maíz blanco se hizo su carne
De pasta de maíz se hicieron los brazos y las piernas del hombre

texts.title_ja: ラビナル・アチ（マヤ戯曲詩）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Aquí estoy, oh Rabinal Achí, aquí estoy ante ti
Dime, ¿qué deseas? ¿qué buscas?
Dime mi nombre, dime mi origen

texts.title_ja: インカ「アタワルパ哀歌（アプ・インカ）」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ñakaq runallaykitam ripukuyman
Apusniyki, intiyki, kawsayniyki sutintayki
Atawallpaykiq qillpunninraqcha

texts.title_ja: オリャンタイ（ケチュア戯曲詩）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ima sumaq qamta munaspaykim
Kawsani munaymanta
Qampa rikrasniykipi

texts.title_ja: ケチュア・ワイノ
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Phuyu phuyullam haqarpaway
Mana imanaymantapas
Kayllapichum sapallay kasaq

texts.title_ja: ナバホ山の歌
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
From the eagle's nest, the eagle takes me
From the eagle's nest, I am taken
Going toward the place of dawn
With beauty all around me

texts.title_ja: ナバホ夜の歌
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
In beauty I walk
With beauty before me I walk
With beauty behind me I walk
With beauty above me I walk

texts.title_ja: ホピ蛇踊歌
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Sister Snake, brother Snake
Carry our prayers to the rain clouds
Make the corn grow tall

texts.title_ja: ズーニー祈願
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Father Sun, mother Earth
We make the cornmeal road
Let our prayers reach the cloud-people

texts.title_ja: ラコタ死の歌
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
It is a good day to die
The fields are full of corn
The rivers run with fish

texts.title_ja: イロコイ感謝の言葉
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Now we turn our thoughts to the Mother Earth
For she has been giving birth from time without end
We give thanks

texts.title_ja: イヌイット・カルツィルニ（待ちの歌）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
And the great voice of the wind speaks
The ice cracks, the seal calls
We wait, watching, alone

texts.title_ja: クムリポ（ハワイ創世讃歌）第3章
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Hānau ka uku-koʻakoʻa
Hānau kāna, he ʻākoʻakoʻa
Hānau ke koʻe-enuhe
Hānau kāna, he koʻe

texts.title_ja: ハワイ・ペレ女神讃歌
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
E hō mai ka ʻike mai luna mai e
E Pele e, e Hiʻiaka e
E hoʻāla mai i ka pō

texts.title_ja: 古典フラ・メレ
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
E aloha mai i ka pua o ka lehua
Ka pua kaulana o Mauna Loa
Kuʻu lei lehua hoʻoheno

texts.title_ja: テ・ラウパラハ「カ・マテ・ハカ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ka mate, ka mate! Ka ora, ka ora!
Ka mate, ka mate! Ka ora, ka ora!
Tēnei te tangata pūhuruhuru
Nāna nei i tiki mai whakawhiti te rā

texts.title_ja: マオリ・ワイアタ・アロハ（恋歌）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Pō pō, e tangi ana Tama ki te kai māna
Waiho me tiki ake ki te Pae-tapu
Hei taringa māu

texts.title_ja: マオリ・モテアテア（古典歌謡）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Pinepine te kura, hau te kura
Whanake te kura
Hanu, hanu te kura

texts.title_ja: タヒチ・ペヘ（古典歌謡）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Te taa nei e te taʻu maitaʻi
Te taʻu nei te poʻe e te ʻuru
Na te atua oranaʻi

texts.title_ja: サモア・タギ（哀歌）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ua tagi le tama matua
Ua tagi le tama matua mo lana atalii
Ua malie le tama matua

texts.title_ja: アボリジニ・ドリーミング歌
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
In the time before time, the ancestors walked
They shaped the rocks and the rivers
They sang the country into being

texts.title_original: Inuit Song of the Old Man
texts.title_ja: イヌイット老人の歌
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
And I think over again my small adventures
My fears, those small ones that seemed so big
For all the vital things I had to get and to reach

texts.title_ja: サーミ・ヨイク
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Vuolláš boahtá, vuolláš loahppá
Dán mu vuolláš lea njálggis
Mu áhkkugii in dahkat osi

texts.title_original: アイヌ・カムイユーカラ「フクロウ」
texts.title_ja: アイヌ・カムイユーカラ（フクロウの神の自叙）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
銀の滴降る降るまわりに
金の滴降る降るまわりに
美しい音を立てて

texts.title_original: アイヌ・ユーカラ「ポイヤウンペ」
texts.title_ja: アイヌ・ユーカラ「ポイヤウンペ叙事詩」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
ポイヤウンペは小さき者なるが
力は獅子のごとく
海をも平らげ山をも越え

texts.title_ja: 古代エジプト「イシスの嘆き」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Come back to me, my brother Osiris
Come back, come back
The heavens grieve, the earth weeps
